svg.title: Neural network architecture: 4→3→2→1 with shape transformations
svg.desc: Four-layer neural network showing input layer with 4 nodes, hidden layer 1 with 3 nodes, hidden layer 2 with 2 nodes, and output layer with 1 node. Each transition shows the matrix dimensions and sigmoid activation.
svg.text: Each weight matrix W compresses the previous layer's vector into fewer dimensions
W¹ is (3×4), W² is (2×3), W³ is (1×2) — rows = next layer size, cols = current layer size
